name: An Ode to Bradley
source:
TO A THOUSAND YEARS OF BRADLEY!!!🥂 

An Ode to Bradley is a visual novel depicting the backstory of the golden boy with the golden coat. Although his perpetual expression of happiness is enough to elate anybody's heart, behind those obsidian pearl eyes may hide a truly tragic tale...

[From [url=https://duckymomo786.itch.io/an-ode-to-bradley]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
致布拉德利一千年！！！🥂 

《布拉德利颂》是一部视觉小说，描绘了金衣男孩的背景故事。虽然他永远的幸福表情足以让任何人心旷神怡，但在那双黑曜石珍珠般的眼睛背后，可能隐藏着一个真正的悲惨故事……

[来自[url=https://duckymomo786.itch.io/an-ode-to-bradley]Itch.io[/url]]
